newsitem.title: USA: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn., May 28 (Reuter) - Signal A.
newsitem.headline: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn., May 28 (Reuter) - Signal A.

text.p: Signal Apparel Co said on Wednesday that it had hired Weatherly Financial Group to advise the company on the possibility of a merger with a middle market screenprinting manufacturer.

Specifically, Signal Apparel said Weatherly would help to develop the company's acquisition strategy by seeking middle market screenprinting and other manufacturers that sell to the retail trade and have revenues of about $10 million.

"Signal Apparel's engagement of Weatherly Financial Group is part of the company's decision to focus on the high-margin, screenprinted activewear market and move away from the low-margin manufacturing of undecorated activewear," the company said in a statement.
Signal Apparel designs and sells juvenile, youth and adult activewear.
